chunks: And in it is that the Imam (peace be upon him) said: It is not permissible for a man to pray alone except in voluntary prayer.
ai.seo_question: Can a man pray obligatory prayers alone according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records this ruling to clarify the distinction between the obligatory (*fard*) and voluntary (*nafl*) prayers, emphasizing the communal nature of the former. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly view that while individual prayer is valid for *nafl*, the congregational prayer (*Salat al-Jama'ah*) holds superior merit and is often considered obligatory for men in the presence of an Imam or in the absence of a valid excuse for isolation.
